xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-shp:DisclosureOfNotesOnShareholdi:
1.Company has implemented Employee Stock Ownership Plan-2021 through JSW Infrastructure Employee Benefit Trust ("Trust") which is in force since 1st February, 2022. As on 30th June, 2026, the Trust holds 65,37,830 (0.28%) equity shares as compared to 148,39,814 (0.71%) equity shares held as on 31st March, 2026. The variation in the shareholding of the trust is on account of sale of Equity Shares pursuant to exercise of options under the aforesaid Employee Stock Ownership Plan-2021. Accordingly, the public shareholding increased by 0.43%.
2.To achieve the Minimum Public Shareholding requirement, the Company, during the quarter ended 30th June 2026, undertook a Qualified Institutions Placement comprising a fresh issue of shares and an Offer for Sale by the Promoter Selling Shareholder. On 26th June 2026, the Company issued and allotted 23,00,00,000 equity shares pursuant to the Fresh Issue, and the Promoter Selling Shareholder transferred 3,32,52,427 equity shares pursuant to the Offer for Sale to qualified institutional buyers. Consequently, the shareholding of Sajjan Jindal Family Trust was reduced from 165,31,35,390 equity shares (78.72%) to 161,98,82,963 equity shares (69.52%). Accordingly, the Company has achieved the Minimum Public Shareholding requirement.
3.Mr. Devki Nandan Sharma is a Whole Time Director (KMP) of the Company, however his shareholding is reflected under Directors & Relative tab.
4.As per the FDI policy, the Company is eligible for 100% investment through automatic route. Further, the Company has taken the approval of shareholders to increase the limit of investment for NRI or OCI from 10% to 24%. Sajjan Jindal Family Trust is the beneficial owner in relation to the equity shares issued to Everbest Consultancy Services Private Limited and Reynold Traders Private Limited.
